test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

Your mother prepares delicious food, did she?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the mismatch between the positive statement and the negative question tag.
 
• The sentence uses the present tense** "prepares," **so the correct question tag should be** "doesn't she?"**
 
• "Did she?" is incorrect because it doesn't match the tense of the main verb **"prepares."**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Your mother prepares delicious food,** doesn't she?**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "prepares delicious food"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "No error"** – This would be correct if there were no errors in the sentence, but "did she?" is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "Your mother"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
